fixtures.preview: 12th-placed United host bottom-of-the-table Spurs, with both sides desperate for a result.
talking_points: United are 12th with 5 points from 5 games, while Spurs are bottom on 2; Michael Carrick calls the pressure "just another game".
Patrick Dorgu (hamstring, out for weeks) and Benjamin Sesko (shin) are out, de Ligt and Ugarte remain sidelined, and Mazraoui is doubtful after a knock on international duty.
Rashford, Amad Diallo and Mainoo have trained and are expected in the squad, and new signing Carlos Baleba is in line to debut.
Spurs are reportedly without long-term absentees Xavi Simons, Wilson Odobert and Mykhailo Mudryk, plus a James Maddison setback.

Sunday trip to Elland Road for the Roses rivalry, moved for Sky Sports in the UK.
Trip to Lake Como in matchday 3 of the Champions League league phase.
Home game against Bournemouth at Old Trafford.
Season-opening Sydney Derby at Allianz Stadium, with both clubs under new head coaches and a full house expected.
talking_points: It is the first time the A-League has opened with a Sydney Derby, and Wanderers coach Ufuk Talay faces his former club.
The Wanderers finished last season with their first wooden spoon, and say they have changed their attitude and "fear none".
Wanderers captain Brandon Borrello leads a new-look group, with Nicolas Milanovic's return seen as a key boost.
Tickets start from $36, with juniors from $22.50 and family packs from $90.
